context_title: llm api provider get 10$ when sign up similar to requesty.ai or llmapi.ai etc

entries.query: llm api provider get 10$ when sign up similar to requesty.ai or llmapi.ai etc
entries.answer:
Several LLM API aggregators and gateway platforms offer promotional trial credits (typically $5 to $25) or permanent zero-cost tiers upon registration.[1][2][3]

***

### Direct Signup Credit Offers

| Provider / Gateway | Typical Credit Offer | Credit Card Required | Key Notes & Models |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Requesty.ai** | $10–$25 trial credits | Usually card verification | Aggregator routing to Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, DeepSeek, and Mistral |
| **LLMAPI.ai** | $10 welcome bonus [4] | Yes (card verification) [4] | Multi-model routing (Claude, GPT, Gemini); ~$10 covers roughly 5,000 standard requests [4] |
| **Novita AI** | $10 via referral / promos [5] | No (varies by campaign) | Open-source endpoints (Llama, DeepSeek, Mistral, Qwen) [5] |
| **NVIDIA NIM** | 1,000 free API credits (~$10–$15 value) | No | High-throughput hosted open-source models (Llama 3+, Mistral, DeepSeek) via `build.nvidia.com` [6] |
| **SambaNova Cloud** | $5 trial credits [2] | No [2] | Ultra-fast inference on Llama 3 models; credits expire in 30 days [2] |

***

### Free Alternative Aggregators

If the objective is testing without immediate upfront payments, several aggregators and inference engines bypass fixed trial balances by offering perpetual free rate limits:[6][7]

- **OpenRouter**: Access to numerous `:free` endpoints (e.g., Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma) with an OpenAI-compatible base URL.[2][7]
- **Google AI Studio (Gemini API)**: Permanent free tier with rate-limited access (RPM/RPD limits) to Gemini models without billing setup required.[7][6]
- **GroqCloud**: Generous free token-per-minute quotas on Llama, Mixtral, and Gemma models focused on low latency.[6][7]
- **Cerebras Cloud**: High-speed inference with ongoing daily free-tier allowances on standard open models.[6]
